correctness.rationale: For K_n square K_2 with OPEN locating-total domination of ALL vertices, same-layer outside signatures are distinct iff at most one matching column is empty; top/bottom cross signatures separate when either layer has at least two selected. Total domination forces two occupied vertices in each nonempty layer except full opposite layer and the one-vertex matched-pair cases. Counting empty columns and column states with weighted inclusion–exclusion yields n>=4 polynomial t^n(t+2)^n+n*t^(n-1)(t+2)^(n-1)-2*n*t^n-2*n^2*t^(n-1), +6*t^2 at n=3, and 4*t^2+4*t^3+t^4 at n=2. It implies min n for 2<=n<=4 and n-1 for n>=5, counts 4,14,56,n(2^(n-1)-2n). Independent from source checker: enumerate all 2^(2n) labeled vertex subsets for each n=2..7 using direct adjacency and open-neighborhood signatures and compare EVERY coefficient, including boundaries. Proof unbounded, finite tests corroborative.
